verdict.rationale: The docs imply parts of the split without stating it as a matrix. The platform must integrate Mangopay's hosted KYC/KYB (mangopay-docs-34). Chargeback amounts are deducted from wallets, and the platform settles its credit to Mangopay unless it contests successfully, which implies the platform bears dispute losses (mangopay-docs-12, mangopay-docs-13). Card-data handling via the vault gives PCI-DSS compliance (mangopay-docs-31), and the platform defines its own fraud rules (mangopay-docs-7). Missing for 10: an explicit responsibility matrix, AML ownership stated outright, card-network compliance ownership beyond PCI, explicit fraud-loss liability, seller-misconduct liability, and independent corroboration.
